verdict.rationale: CDP documents a Custom Stablecoins product for issuing a branded stablecoin backed 1:1 by USDC, with Coinbase managing issuance, redemption, and reserves. That covers the core of the story, but the evidence is a single overview line and says nothing about who can access the product. Missing for 10: honest disclosure of gating (eligibility, approval, or enterprise/sales-only access), detailed minting/redemption API docs, specifics on reserve management and attestation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
